fragments.text: Thou hast revealed Thyself in the cloud of Thy glory to Thy holy people in order to speak with them, from heaven hast Thou made Thy voice heard to them and in clouds of purity hast Thou revealed Thyself to them. The whole world trembled before Thee and the creatures of the creation were in awe of Thee when Thou didst reveal Thyself, O our King, on Mount Sinai in order to teach Thy people Torah and commandment. Thou didst make them hear the majesty of Thy voice and Thy holy words out of fiery flames. With thunder and lightning didst Thou reveal Thyself to them and with the sound of the Shofar didst Thou appear to them.
